title: 1987 Fleer Glossy #197 Kal Daniels Cincinnati Reds Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1987 Fleer Glossy sports trading card featuring Kal Daniels of the Cincinnati Reds. The card is from the MLB set and is numbered 197. It is a glossy parallel variety of the base set, manufactured by Fleer. Perfect for collectors of sports trading cards, especially those interested in baseball and the Cincinnati Reds.
